note: Rustic wooded campground on the west shore of Strawberry Lake in Turtle Mountain State Forest, NE of Bottineau, run by the North Dakota Forest Service. Trout lake with a fishing pier, canoe access and a swimming area; gas boat motors are prohibited. Trail access to 18 miles of non-motorized trails. Most sites are small and wooded; reviews say only a few fit larger campers, and the Forest Service posts no pad lengths. --Claude
summary: ND Forest Service page + June 2025 campground map read: primitive FCFS sites, $20/night (was $15 in the note), self-registration, two drinking-water wells, vault toilets, 13 sites numbered 20-32 on the map. Groups written; note cleaned. Pin ok. Not waterfront stands (canopy). Website and phone updates below.

Strawberry Lake is described with 'campsites, two wells for drinking water, boat ramp, fishing pier, group camping area, picnic area and vault toilet facilities' and trail access to 'multi-use, non-motorized trails'; no horse facilities at Strawberry Lake.
